headline: Jack Grealish: Foot injury - 75% chance of playing
raw_text: Jack Grealish: Foot injury - 75% chance of playing
text: Grealish misses Man City tour despite training return. Jack Grealish will not make his return in a Manchester City shirt after being left out of the club's pre-season tour of Asia as he continues to recover from a foot injury.
